Andhra Pradesh Extraordinary Gazette index 2025 (G.O.Ms.No.514, Revenue (Lands-IV), 30 Dec 2025: shifting of Nandigama mandal from Palasa to Tekkali revenue division)
List of ULBs and UDAs covered under PMAY-U 2.0 (MoHUA, Government of India)

notes: The official mandals page lists 30 mandals by division and already shows Nandigam under Tekkali division marked 'w.e.f 31/12/2025', consistent with G.O.Ms.No.514. The same page's introductory text still says '38 Mandals', which is stale pre-2022 text; the table has 30. The official site spells the mandal 'Nandigam' while the G.O. title uses 'Nandigama'; the site spelling is used. ULBs are taken from the MoHUA PMAY-U 2.0 ULB list because the CDMA site loads its ULB directory by JavaScript and could not be read; Palakonda and Rajam ULBs are listed there under Parvathipuram Manyam and Vizianagaram respectively and are excluded here.
